values: 一名残忍的坦克，战斗中会使用巨斧和药剂与敌人作战。
A ruthless tank who knocks down enemies with a giant axe and poisonous potions.
Marr, don't let a single one escape!
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
Hmm. What are you staring at, moron?
I caught it from you, you oaf.
还算有用的东西，我收着了。啊？
(Kar) Something actually useful. I'll keep it. (Mar) Huh?
还算有用的东西，我收着了。
Something actually useful. I'll keep it.
(Kar) Not interested. Give it to Mar. (Mar) Yeah!
Not interested. Give it to Mar.
他们是不是很想被我们砍成两半？
Do you think they're itching to be sliced in two?
马尔，我们什么时候撕碎他们？
Mar, when do we get to tear them apart?
这些食物连塞牙缝都不够！
These scraps aren't even enough to get stuck in my teeth!
喀尔和马尔是一对双胞胎兄弟，但并非一出生就是连体人。传言他们如今的样貌与班题斯有着密不可分的关系。
Kar and Mar are twin brothers, but they were not conjoined at birth. Word is that Bantus has something to do with their current condition.
马尔曾经告诉别人，他如今的身躯上一共有537道缝合线。对此喀尔立刻反驳：不要相信马尔的数数水平。
Mar once claimed to have exactly 537 stitches on his body. Kar's response? "Don't trust Mar. He's hopeless with numbers."
在战场上，喀尔和马尔是令人威风丧胆的班题斯刽子手。他们对于屠戮与鲜血的渴望并非出自仇怨，而是源于与生俱来的嗜血天性。
Kar and Mar are fearsome Bantus slayers. Their affinity for violence stems not from grudges or hatred, but from an innate bloodlust.
在喀尔内心里，他一直非常看不起出身班题斯贵族阶级的亡灵，其中也包括托安最忠诚的禁卫——格瑞泽尔勒。
Deep down, Kar has always despised the Bantus nobility, including Grezhul, Thoran's most loyal guard.
对于大多数生者和亡灵而言，喀尔调配的药剂都是毒药。然而喀尔和马尔却能将这些毒药当作水来饮用。
Kar's concoctions are poisonous to most living and Graveborn alike, yet Kar and Mar can drink them like water.
喀尔和马尔在班题斯军队里没有朋友，因为这副可怖的模样足以吓跑所有怀揣善意的亡灵。即使没有，他们也会用斧头和毒药告诫你：他们不需要朋友。

Kar and Mar have no friends in the Bantus army, as their dreadful appearance drives everyone away. Not that they mind in the slightest—their axe and poison make it abundantly clear that they do not need friends.
有些时候，为了报复喀尔的咒骂，马尔会用斧头猛击自己的脚——他对疼痛的忍耐力似乎比喀尔强不少。
One of Mar's ways of getting back at Kar for his insults is to slam his own feet with his axe. His pain tolerance, it seems, is considerably higher than his brother's.
马尔头上的伤痕出自一位耀光骑士之手，而喀尔鲜少提及是谁造成了他头部的伤——兄弟两人十岁时曾为了谁能多拿一个土豆而争吵，马尔一怒之下把喀尔的头摁在了铁砧上。

While the scar on Mar's head was the doing of a Lightbearer knight, Kar rarely speaks of his own. In truth, it came from Mar, who pinned Kar's head against an anvil after the two fought over a potato at the age of ten.
加入班题斯后，托安曾要求喀尔和马尔在杀人时尽量留下全尸，以此作为肢体的储备来源，这令喀尔非常困扰：虽然劝住马尔不算难事，但束手束脚的杀戮实在不痛快。

Thoran once told Kar and Mar to leave their victims intact so their limbs could be used as spares. Kar wasn't pleased. He didn't mind keeping Mar in check, but having to hold back took all the fun out of killing.
斧头上的头骨，取材于某次抢掠时死在他们手下的一对兄妹。二人拼死也要保护对方，为此放弃了唯一的逃生机会——既然这么舍不得对方，那就永远绑在一起吧。

The skulls mounted on their axe belonged to a brother and sister killed during a raid. Since the siblings gave up their chance to escape to stick with each other, Kar and Mar made sure they stayed together forever.
他们是不是很想被我们砍成两半？
Do you think they're itching to be sliced in two?
这些食物连塞牙缝都不够！
These scraps aren't even enough to get stuck in my teeth!
